expected.title: Corrected exceptional-set dimension bounds for random S-adic cocycles on Oseledets subspaces containing the unstable bundle
expected.author: Alexander I. Bufetov; Boris Solomyak
expected.difficulty_reason: Oseledets estimates and the cited exponential-tail result do not directly bound the exceptional set of parameters uniformly over the frequency interval. The author builds a lattice-prediction scheme, counts its exceptional choices by an entropy estimate, and combines the unstable-projection cover with the complementary Oseledets directions. The corrected order of choosing the parameters is essential to that dimension bound, and the entire authored covering construction remains in the packet.

source_locator.correction_scope: For every epsilon1>0 there exist delta0>0 and rho>0; then for almost every a and every delta in(0,delta0), every B>1 and each eligible Oseledets subspace, the dimension bound holds. Proof unchanged according to official author corrigendum.

material.preserved_editorial_scope:
\paragraph{Editorial problem boundary.}
Prove only Proposition 5.4 in the official corrected quantifier order given in Corrigendum DOI 10.5802/jep.212 below. For every \(\epsilon_1>0\), the parameters \(\delta_0\) and \(\varrho\) are chosen before the typical cocycle and the smaller \(\delta\). All original Theorem 4.1 hypotheses, lattice-prediction, entropy-covering and unstable-projection core are retained. The original 2021 statement is kept only as superseded historical context; the authors explicitly say that the corrected statement has the unchanged original proof. No finite Hausdorff measure at the exact critical exponent or translation-flow application is selected.
